title: Lolita

vibeProfile.oneLine: A monster's seductive voice, in Nabokov's dazzling, disturbing masterpiece.

summary: Humbert Humbert, a cultured European and self-justifying monster, narrates his obsession with and abuse of a twelve-year-old girl he calls Lolita, in some of the most dazzling and seductive prose ever written in English. Nabokov's notorious masterpiece dares the reader to be charmed by a predator's voice, and in doing so becomes a profound study of desire, delusion and the treachery of beautiful language. Brilliant and deeply disturbing, it is a novel that demands to be read with open eyes.
whyReadIt: Nabokov's dazzling, disturbing masterpiece, a monster's seductive voice you must read with open eyes. Brilliant and unsettling.

funFacts.text: Several publishers rejected it before it appeared in Paris in 1955, sparking immediate scandal.
